Hi
Hi there! Welcome to Ting-A-Ling Schools. How can I help you today?
What ages do Ting-A-Ling start from?

Great question! We have two schools, so it depends which one you're asking about:

- **Pre-Primary School** takes children from **2 to 6 years old**
- **Special Needs School** takes children from **3 to 12 years old**

Which one were you interested in? 😊
Pre-Primary School

Our Pre-Primary School welcomes children from **2 to 6 years old**. We use a play-based learning approach with English integrated into the daily programme, and we offer half-day options as well. You can find us at 74 Krewilkring, Meerensee — feel free to pop in for a tour! 🙂
What are the operating hours?
Our Pre-Primary School runs from **07:00 to 17:00** weekdays, with different time options to suit your needs. The office is open from 07:00 to 15:30 if you need to pop in or give us a call. 😊
How much are the school fees?

Here are the Pre-Primary School fees — they depend on which time slot you choose:

| Hours | Fee per month |
|-------|:-------------:|
| 07:00 – 13:00 | **R1,900** |
| 07:00 – 15:00 | **R2,000** |
| 07:00 – 17:00 | **R2,200** |

Fees are due on the 2nd of each month and payable for 11 months (January to November). There's also a one-time registration fee of R1,300. 😊
Is the school open during june/july holidays

Yes, the school does offer holiday programmes during the school breaks, including the June/July holiday period. The specific dates and details do vary, so it's best to give the office a call closer to the time for exact dates and to secure your child's spot. 😊

If you'd like more details, you can contact the school office at **info@tingalingschools.com**, **0615274429** or **0724561282** during office hours (07:00–15:30 weekdays).
Does the school provide breakfast or lunch

That information isn't available in what I have. I'd suggest giving the school office a call — they'll be able to let you know what's included. 😊

You can reach them at **info@tingalingschools.com**, **0615274429** or **0724561282** during office hours (07:00–15:30 weekdays).
Where and how do i pay school fees monthly

School fees can be paid via **EFT, Debit Order, or Cash**, and they're due on the **2nd of each month** (January to November). If you'd like the school's banking details for EFT or to set up a debit order, it's best to contact the office and they'll assist you with everything. 😊

You can reach them at **info@tingalingschools.com**, **0615274429** or **0724561282** during office hours (07:00–15:30 weekdays).

You're very welcome! If you ever have any other questions about Ting-A-Ling Schools, feel free to ask. 😊
